assigned_fix.root_cause: The failing page was the static index.html shell (footer links only): React never mounted. The test loaded www.roselabs.ai 6 s after Vercel switched production to 0ee70b27c (READY 08:59:10Z). Entry chunk hashes change every build and the project has no skew protection, so a document held across the switch requested an /assets/index-*.js that now 404s; the only stale-build recovery (src/lib/appVersion.ts) lives inside the bundle that failed to load.
assigned_fix.fix: Inline guard in front-end/index.html ahead of the module entry: on a module-script load error reload with 0.5/1/2 s backoff, at most 3 times per entry URL (sessionStorage, window.name fallback); attempts are charged only when the reload runs and an offline page waits for the online event.
assigned_fix.regression: front-end/tests-e2e/entry-load-recovery.spec.ts (semantic suite): recovery after an entry 404, reload bound, offline-during-backoff
assigned_fix.pre_fix: original test body + injected entry 404 on the prod build: identical TimeoutError at select() and identical footer-only snapshot; new spec fails on prod (no mount; 1 load instead of 4)
assigned_fix.post_fix: original test x5 + injected variant x5 10/10; new spec 15/15 on prod, E2E-fixture and dev builds
